title: Grusch: Oppenheimer set up UFO secrecy

tellings.quote: if you believe David grush then they literally set up the secrecy

plain: The physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer, who led the building of the atomic bomb, and others of his time are said to have set up the secrecy around UFOs in the 1940s and 1950s. Michels raises this from David Grusch, a former intelligence official who has spoken publicly about UFOs, and says "if you believe David Grusch then they literally set up the secrecy." He also brings in the scientist Robert Sarbacher. If true, the cover-up would go back to the same men who built the bomb.
